'''Dokath-Ra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Dokath-Ra decided to help the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Thelonia Redrish]] in her quest to pass the Mystic's Spirit Trial and for this Dokath ordered his apprentice [[Shajahm-Do]] to conducted to him a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Tormen]] sent after Thelonia. But when Dokath met the Hunter he couldn't convince them to rest in peace so a fight erupted and the Hunter killed Dokath and all the other pro-Republic mystics before they resumed the hunt for Thelonia.<ref name="Nihilistic Mystics" />
